title: Nondeterministic oracle Turing machine
statement: A nondeterministic oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, a symbol alphabet, and a state set consists of an initial state, a query state, a positive-answer state, a negative-answer state, and two transition functions indexed by a choice bit. Each transition function takes a state, the possibly blank symbol under the input head, and the scanned symbols on the $k$ ordinary work tapes together with the query tape, and returns a one-step action on those $k+1$ tapes.
hypotheses_covered: A nonnegative number $k$ of ordinary work tapes
Two transition functions indexed by a Boolean choice
